summary: Mega Matrix Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held June 22, 2026. Shareholders approved election of four directors, a reverse share consolidation of 20:1 (with a minimum ratio of 3:1) on the company's Class A, B, and C ordinary shares, adoption of amended & restated memorandum and articles of association, and appointment of Audit Alliance LLP as auditor for FY2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no special-situation event.
